The purpose is to design an laptop based web-application intended to:
Access basic student and staff information of The LNM Institute of Information Technology for authentication.
Create personalized accounts for authenticated users.
Reducing paperwork.
Automate bus reservation and cancellation system.
Digitize the above and also the payment system for the same

The technical terms and conventions will be in italics.
Some abbreviations have been used.
SRS - Software Requirements Specification
TBD - To Be Developed
BMC - Bus Management Committee
SS - Student Services (refers to entire LNMIIT family who wish to avail the bus services )
The priority of a requirement is specified at the end of that requirement,
where ‘nn’ is an integer in the range 00 (lowest priority) to 99 (highest priority).

This document is created for:
The software development team for their use in analyzing the requirements.
The members of the BMC of the institute to review and suggest refinements if any.
The IT department of the institute for their review and approval.

The scope of the TBD Digital Bus Automation System is:
To enable the viewers to securely access the software via the internet in order to make a booking, view the bus time table, cancel a booking and create a bill for all transactions.
To automatically create monthly reports of services incurred by the users and store in the RDBMS database.

The following are the key product features to be delivered by the product:
Features pertaining to BMC members:
Login to the portal using lnmiit domain id and other details(see Appendix A).
Contact BMC Help Team for any help regarding registrations of BMC members.
Update the database of BMC users.
With the approval of the BMC president(Refer Appendix A) ​the following functions are permitted :
Add, update, delete bus time table.
Update bus details .i.e type of bus, number of seats, bus number etc.
Update details of the bus drivers.
Allow BMC to add extra buses or update existing bus routes and​ post a notification regarding the same on the public notification board.
View booking details(refer Appendix A) like booking ID, date of reservation, trip date, user name etc. Also transaction details from the payment gateway, bus numbers etc.
All features available to viewers as mentioned below.
Features pertaining to the viewers:
Allow users to view the updated time table and the associated details of the bus .i.e details of the bus driver, bus type etc.
Login to the portal using lnmiit domain id and other details (refer Appendix A).
Access to help and FAQ page for bookings and registrations.
Allow users to select and book ​a limited number ​of seats(refer Business Rules) - selected seats while booking will appear green while booked seats will appear grey.
Give ​selected​(refer System Features) users priority to choose from reserved seats.
Allow users to pay for the ticket from their e-wallet. The money to the wallet can be added online via Debit card, Credit Card, Net Banking or Paytm using a payment gateway.
Generate a booking ID for each booking which will be used to authenticate the user boarding the bus.
Allow users to cancel their booking before a ​certain deadline​(refer Business Rules 5.5). The refund will be as per the cancellation policy(5.5).
View bookings via booking ID.
View their own personal notification board

This software package will be used by three categories of users:
Admins/Members of the BMC​: These users will use the software to generate or modify the bus services provided, eligibility rules and process activities and flow.
Students and Staff of the institute​: This comes under the head ​Student Services(SS). These users will use the software to find out about the services available at any given time and also avail them as per the business rules.
BMC President: ​This user will use the software for managing the approvals for the changes made by the rest of the BMC.

The design time constraints are:
More than 1,000 users should be able to concurrently access the bus automation system per day from all parts of the college.

This software package will come with On-line Help (web pages) for each of the two types of users (i.e. BMC team and SS) on how to use the facilities available for them.
There will be an FAQ page(answered by the BMC), Query submission link, display of helpline numbers and also pages pertaining to the rules and policies of the product, cancellation policy etc. product, cancellation policy etc.
The details of the (i) Analysis, (ii) Design and (iii) Test Cases of this software package will be delivered along with this software.

4.1 .1 Description and Priority
The TBD software package should facilitate the BMC to:
Upload a new bus time table including its associated buses, routes and driver details with the approval of the BMC President.
ii) Modify an existing bus time table and its associated details with the approval of the BMC President.
iii) Activate a newly added bus time table OR reactivate a modified bus time table with effect from activation date and time;
iv) Deactivate an existing bus time table with effect from a date and time.
Recent Updates will be posted on the Notification panel on home screen.
The priority of this requirement is 99 (without this facility, other requirements do not work).

Reliability​ - The application should be reliable and it should generate all updated information in correct order.
​Availability​ - Application should be available and working properly for 24x7.
The software is intended to make a digital and paperless system. Hence for security reasons a daily report will be generated by the system and stored in the college database.

The following business rules are to be followed:
The user can pre book a bus ticket upto one day prior to the actual bus trip.
Cancellation Policy:
If a booking stands cancelled by the user 120 minutes prior to the concerned trip, the user will be worthy of refund of the total amount.
If a cancellation occurs 60-120 minutes prior to the trip, the user will be entitled for half amount of refund.
If a cancellation occurs in less than 60 minutes to the trip, no refund will be provided to the user.
For the refund process, the user will enter the mode of refund.
The ​selected seats ​refer to the 6 reserved seats for faculty and staff user category in each bus. These will be shown as booked for the other SS.
If the ​selected seats​ are vacant 60 minutes prior to the trip or if the cancelled seats create a vacancy, a notification will be sent to all users in the waiting list of that particular trip. Rules for allocation waiting list users:
If number of seats available >= waitlist number of first in list : Allocate
If number of seats available < waitlist number of first user then allocate to the next user which satisfies the above clause.
To board the bus, the user must type a booking id(created after a successful booking) on a keypad installed in the bus.
A user can book a maximum of 6 tickets for round-trips during one transaction.
Children with age >=5 years should be bought a separate ticket.
Bus Schedule Updation Approval : The BMC President is entitled to approve/disapprove a bus schedule updation within 12 hours, after which the schedule stands correct and is activated as per the activation date and time mentioned in the new time table. If no activation details are mentioned, the schedule will automatically get activated after 24 hours of the approval.
With the approval of DoSA, BMC has the right to book any number of seats in a bus apart from the ​selected seats​(point 3). This could be in lieu with the students going for coaching regularly, some special trip planned by college to nearby visit etc. The remaining seats will be open for all users.
Valid booking ​: This refers to the time slot aspect. No user can book for a trip which has already started or ended for the day. For instance, one cannot book a 2:00 PM bus at 5:00 PM. Once the trip starts, no more bookings are to be accepted.
The cost for a single way trip is fixed to Rs 25. The user can book 6 tickets maximum at a time which requires Rs 150 (Rs 25 x 6=150).
The minimum balance in a user wallet to book a ticket is fixed at Rs 150. Below the amount, the user will be unable to book any further tickets.
In case a student is graduating or leaving the college, he can apply for a refund equal to his/her current wallet balance in the accounts section.
As the user logs in to make a booking, the login id is used to segregate them into various categories- selected users (faculty and staff), special category of users(reserved seats by DoSA approval) and the normal users.
First category has access to all seats except the reserved ones by DoSA approval.
Second category has access to all seats except the 6 selected seats.
Third category does not have access to selected and reserved seats.
All the buses have a unique 3 digit code for each day. First digit signifies departure place. Second digit the destination place. Third digit which number of bus it is since morning.
Example : If LNMIIT is code 1, Raja park is code 2.
The very first bus in the morning will have number ​121 :​ which means first bus from college to Raja Park.
